description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 11 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of an appropriation statute for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves legal modifications to financial legislation (Appropriation Statute No. 02 of 2006 as amended), which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and legal amendments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
